wedging_risk — DRIVE pegfail op

• Data kinds: table × scalar → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.wedging_risk(kp, theta: 'float', margin_deg: 'float' = 0.5) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import pegfail; pegfail.wedging_risk(kp, theta: 'float', margin_deg: 'float' = 0.5) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("wedging_risk"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

傾き θ [rad] のくさびの危険度: 境目 c/μ(OCW p.28)に対する比 θ/(c/μ) と、余裕 margin_deg を見た 3 段(safe / near / over)。pegsim.wedging_check を包み、theta_limit_deg・headroom_deg = c/μ − θ を度で足す。μ = 0 では境目が inf で常に safe。Raises ValueError: θ < 0、margin_deg < 0。
